summary.en: The Philippine Coast Guard is containing a 25 liter used-oil spill off Mariveles, Bataan, and has removed 800 kg of oil-contaminated debris while the DENR orders assessment and containment. China has deployed more than 100 warships and coast guard vessels across the western Pacific and sent a survey vessel with unidentified equipment into Scarborough Shoal, raising maritime tension. The Maritime Security Initiative is providing lasting capability assistance to Southeast Asian partners, including the Philippines. The PCG delivered 7,000 DSWD food packs to disaster-affected residents in Batanes as security preparations continue for the upcoming ASEAN Summit in Manila. 176 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Filippinernes kystvakt inneholder et 25‑liter bruktoljesøl utenfor Mariveles, Bataan, og har fjernet 800 kg oljeforurenset avfall mens DENR har beordret vurdering og innkapsling. Kina har satt i drift mer enn 100 krigsskip og kystvaktskip i det vestlige Stillehavet og sendt et undersøkelsesfartøy med ukjent utstyr inn i Scarborough-revet, noe som øker spenningen til sjøs. Maritime Security Initiative gir varig kapasitetsstøtte til sørøstasiatiske partnere, inkludert Filippinene. PCG leverte 7 000 DSWD-matpakker til innbyggere i Batanes som er rammet av katastrofen, mens sikkerhetsforberedelser fortsetter for det kommende ASEAN-toppsmøtet i Manila. 176 kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Moro conflict
background.extract: The Moro conflict was an insurgency in the Mindanao region in southern Philippines which involved multiple armed groups. A decades-long peace process has resulted in peace deals between the Philippine government and two major armed groups, the Moro National Liberation Front (MNLF) and the Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF), but other smaller armed groups continue to exist. In 2017, the peace council settled around 138 clan conflicts.
